Revised Academic Regulations
             For
Higher Secondary Courses, 2025




                                 © ASSEB
                        Key Points
• The Secondary Education (Class XI & XII) shall comprise of
  three streams viz. Arts, Science and Commerce.
• The Vocational Stream has been replaced by Skill Subject
  w.e.f. the academic session 2025-2026.
• The subjects offered under the Vocational Stream will be
  offered as Skill Subjects in integration of Academic Elective
  as per guideline of NEP-2020.
• Any student after having passed the Class 10th examination
  from ASSEB Div.-I or any other recognized boards of Govt.
  of India as well as Govt. of Assam may take admission in the
  H. S. Course.


                                                        © ASSEB
                 Key Points
• The duration of the Higher Secondary course
  (Class XI and XII) shall be of two (2)
  consecutive academic years.
• Each period of instruction shall be of 45
  minutes duration. The Board may, however,
  relax the duration of a period to 40 minutes
  on special consideration.



                                         © ASSEB
      Change of Subjects/ Stream
• Students are to be counseled to offer those subjects in
  Class XI which they would like to continue in Class XII
  and are available in the school at the time of admission
  as well as having competent teachers .
• However, to address some unwarranted issues (such as
  medical/ any exigencies) or if the student is not
  capable of coping with the subject(s)or stream etc.
  request for change of subject(s)or stream in Class XI &
  XII will be accepted provided such a request has been
  made before 31st October for Class XI and 15th July for
  Class XII of that particular academic session by the
  institution .
• Standard Operating Procedures have been framed are
  as under

                       Examination
• The result of the H. S. Final Examination will be determined on
  the basis of the marks obtained in H. S. Final Examination only.
• No credit of Class XI examination shall be counted towards the
  result of H. S. Final Examination.
• The H. S. Final Examination shall be held in the month of
  February-March.
• ASSEB, Div-II will conduct Repeat (Betterment) and
  Compartmental examination etc. maximum within 3 months
  after declaration of the H. S. Final Examination results in the year
  2027.




                                                            © ASSEB
    UNIT TEST – Half yearly - ANNUAL
      EXAM & Revisionary Test
• The District Examination Committee will conduct Internal
  Examination of Class XI and XII as per Government Guideline
  including Annual Examination of Class XI. The Question Papers
  should be concept based as far as practicable.
• The district Examination Committee will conduct revisionary test (
  earlier termed as PRE TEST ) for H. S. 2nd Year class through the
  concerned institutions to assess the student's understanding of
  previously learned material by providing them with an opportunity
  to review key concepts and identify areas where further study is
  needed. The main motto is to help them prepare for upcoming
  examinations and improve their overall knowledge retention.
• ASSEB will provide a portal to enter the marks secured by each
  candidate in all the Internal Examination. The student whose
  marks of Unit Test-1/ Half Yearly Examination of Class XII are
  entered in the portal will only be eligible to appear in the H. S.
  Final Examination.

                                                            © ASSEB
       PERCENATGE OF ATTENDANCE
• Any student who has studied a regular course either in
  the Class XI or in the Class XII may be admitted to the
  Class XI Examination or to the H. S. Final Examination in
  the appropriate stream as a regular            candidate
  provided he/she attended 75% of the classes held in
  each subject.
• A candidate, who fails to attend 75% of the classes on
  medical ground or for any other reasonable ground,
  may also be allowed to appear in the Class XI
  Examination or H. S. Final Examination as the case may
  be, on the basis of performance of the student in the
  Internal Examinations such as Unit Test/ Half Yearly
  Examination etc. with the permission of the ASSEB as a
  regular candidate.

                                                    © ASSEB
     The Scheme of Study for +2 stage
• There will be 6 compulsory subjects in total for all students.
• Subjects to be taken in each stream are divided in groups
  namely A, B, & C.
• A candidate shall opt all the Core subjects listed under part
  A and Elective subjects listed in Part B & C as specified.
• Each candidate has to opt 4[Four] elective subjects
  compulsorily. These elective subjects will be of 100 marks,
  may be with practical or without practical.
• In addition to the 4[Four] elective subjects, a candidate
  shall have to compulsorily study Environmental Education
  in Class XI and General Studies in Class XII for 50 marks
  each. The assessment of the subjects will be done
  internally (institution where studying) and Grade will be
  awarded.

 ADDITIONAL SUBJECTS IN GROUP C
• Add on certificate course :
  Students of H. S. Course are also allowed to register
  simultaneously in Infosys Springboard, which offers a
  variety of free, online digital learning and re-skilling
  programs focused on digital literacy, competency, and
  proficiency, including courses in areas like experience
  (Infosys Aster), insight (Infosys Topaz), innovation
  (Blockchain), acceleration (Enterprise Agile Dev Ops),
  and assurance (Cyber Security). These may be treated
  as subject from Group C and marks awarded by the
  Infosys will be incorporated in mark sheet of Class XI
  and XII.

                                                    © ASSEB
                         Notes
• It is desired that student of all streams shall choose
  their elective subjects keeping in view of their future
  courses of higher studies in general and other
  professional courses in particular.
• Every learner at the +2 stage would be required to
  participate compulsorily in an area of co-curricular
  activities (CCA) out of NCC, NSS, Rover/ Ranger, Games
  and Sports (Any one from Athletic and other team
  games), Cultural and Literary, Debating and Quiz.
• For providing of additional certificates to the students
  for acquiring skills by taking one subject from group C,
  each district will have to choose some agencies in their
  district. Detailed guidelines will be provided in due
  course

                                                    © ASSEB
                  Passing Criteria
• PASS MARKS FOR Class XI EXAMINATION
  – In the Class XI Examination, a candidate has to pass in both
    the MCQ type part and descriptive type part of the
    subject separately with 33% of marks as well as in the
    practical/ project portion and theoretical portion of the
    subjects, with compulsorily 33% of marks separately.
  – ASSEB will issue instructions to Internal Examination
    Committee to prepare 4[Four] sets of OMR for selected
    subjects to conduct the examinations. The list of selected
    subjects shall be notified time to time.
  – After completion of the evaluation of the scripts and
    online posting of marks of Annual Examination of Class XI ,
    ASSEB will allow downloading of e-Marks Sheet by the
    students.

                                                         © ASSEB
                     Passing Criteria
• PASS MARKS FOR H. S. Final YEAR EXAMINATION
   – The minimum pass marks is 33% of the total mark for all
     subjects.
   – For a subject having practical/ project parts the minimum
     pass marks shall be 33% of the marks allocated to the theory
     part and 33% of the marks allocated to the practical/ project
     part.
   – In H. S. course curricula, the student must have to appear in
     6[six] subjects and the result will be declared as PASS, only if
     the students will secure 33% of marks in aggregate, in spite
     of the fact that even if he fails in one subject. However,
     passing in English and MIL/Alt. Eng. is compulsory.



                                                             © ASSEB
                  Passing Criteria
– As a candidate has offered 6 subjects, the decision to
  determine the best 5 subjects may be taken by the admitting
  institution/ employer. Further, it is informed that the ASSEB
  does not calculate/ declare/ inform percentage of marks. If
  the percentage of marks is required for higher education or in
  employment the calculation, if any, may be done by admitting
  institution or employer.
– ASSEB Div-II will award subject-wise grades to the candidates
  in class XI from the academic year 2025-26 & in Class XII Final
  Examinations from the academic year 2026-27 along with the
  marks secured by them in each subject. The awarded grades
  with marks shall be reflected in the Mark-sheet cum
  Certificate issued to the candidates of class XI & XII as
  mentioned above.
– In skill based subject(s), the ratio of practical and theoretical
                                                           © ASSEB
  part will be in the ratio of 50:50.
       Passing Criteria for CWSN
• In case of Physically Handicapped
  students, Passing in English or
  MIL/Alt. Eng. and the remaining
  4[Four]      elective    subjects      is
  compulsory as per Board’s passing
  criteria to get the passing certificate.

                                      © ASSEB
     Examination –Repeat (Betterment)
•   Every year after the declaration of result of HS Final Examination of regular
    candidates , Repeat ( Betterment ) exam will be held and it will be kept in mind
    that they will not have loose academic year .
•   Passed out students can appear in the Repeat (Betterment) Examination only once
    and in the subsequent examination.
•   Candidate can appear in the Repeat/ Compartmental examinations in any one of
    the subjects which he/ she has selected in the previous Regular examination only.
•   If any candidate appears in Repeat (betterment) exam, then his/her result of
    Repeat exam will contain the best marks awarded in main exam or betterment
    /Repeat will be taken for first three years after that marks of repeat exam will only
    be retained and the result of his/ her previous examination will be nullified.
•   In Repeat (Betterment) and Compartmental Exam, every candidate has to bear the
    Fees. Subject wise fees will be applicable in case of such examinations.
• The students appearing in the Revised Betterment of Result Scheme need
  not to appear in Practical/Project Examination if subject(s) contains
  Practical/Project. The original mark obtained for the above shall be
  considered for the fresh mark sheet .


                                                                               © ASSEB
                       Notes
• It is desirable that for ensuring adequate
  exposure to the prescribed laboratory techniques
  practical classes must be started in Class XI class.
• A student must attend the minimum number of
  classes as specified under the Regulations to
  become eligible for admission into Class XI or H.S.
  Final Examination as the case may be.

• The Board desires that Unit test should be held
  regularly as indicated in the Academic Calendar.

                                                © ASSEB
       PERMISSION-RECOGNITION
• In case of Government /Provincialised institution /SSA
  established institution permission /recognition shall be
  accorded as soon as receipt of order from the competent
  authority and on receipt of requisite payment
• In case of Private institution permission /recognition shall
  be accorded on receipt of application in prescribed format
  with all required information particularly of land and
  building and order of Final Registration or Provisional
  Registration received from competent authority under
  relevant Acts and Rules of Government of Assam and after
  proper enquiry as required . Final order shall be issued
  only after receipt of requisite fee and satisfactory enquiry
  report .


                                                       © ASSEB
       PERMISSION-RECOGNITION
• Once Recognition – Permission accorded to an
  Institution will remain valid till it is withdrawn by the
  Board
• The Board may withdraw the permission, if it is found
  that the institution had violated the instructions of the
  Board, indulged in unfair means , Results are
  unsatisfactory , ethical lapse etc and non enrolment of
  students continuously for two years .
• The permission fee Rs. 15000/ per institution plus cost
  of inspection etc for the permission and renewal fee of
  Rs. 1000/ per institution first at the time of Registration
  of Students for class XI and again at the time of form
  fill up of HS final Exam

                                                      © ASSEB
         PERMISSION-RECOGNITION
• If an institute applied for permission of any one of the subject from
  Physics , Chemistry and Biology , that institution shall be treated as
  an institute of Science stream . This institute must have separate
  labs for Physics , Chemistry and Biology. There should also be lab
  for the subjects like Mathematics, Geology, Anthropology etc.
  where ever applicable.
• If an institute applied for permission of the subjects - Accountancy
  and Business Studies, that institution shall be treated as an
  institute of Commerce stream
• If any subject requires laboratory infrastructure is required, then
  the school must have such facility.
• Schools having subjects such as Dance, Music etc. must be
  recognized by some certified institutions as mandated by the Govt.
• The teachers of the institution must be qualified as per the norms
  of NCTE and the infrastructure must be in accordance with the
  requirement of the institution as well as required under different
  rules and regulations.

                                                                © ASSEB
  PROVISION OF ADMISSION IN ASSAM STATE OPEN SCHOOL
• ASSEB, Div-II provides an alternative mode of school
  education in a flexible manner in order to cater to the
  needs of the learners who want to continue the H.S. Course
  of education. The drop out, unsuccessful learners and the
  learner desires to study certain subjects may get enrol in
  the course.
• Admission Provisions:
  A. Regular Admission: Any class 10th passed out.
  B. TOC Admission: Unsuccessful students of H. S.
  Final Examination within 5[Five] years of appearing in
  the examination.


                                                     © ASSEB
 • Mode of Instructions
  – Personal Contact Programmes are conducted through
    Accredited Study Centres. Self Learning Materials are
    provided.
• Medium of Instructions
  – Assamese and English
• Admission Schedule :
  – April to September : A Block
  – October to March,(next academic year) : B Block
• Examination Schedule
  – 1st Examination            : April – May
  – Subsequent Examination     : October-November

                                                      © ASSEB
 • Passing Criteria for SOS
  – A minimum of 33% marks in the aggregate as Pass
    in 5 subjects including at least one but not more
    than two languages as well as separately in theory
    and practical in the Examination.
• Subjects Offered –
  – Assamese, English, Bengali, Bodo, Mathematics,
    Physics, Chemistry, Biology,    Home     Science,
    Economics, Swadesh Adhyayan, Geography, Pol.
    Science,     Business    Studies,   Accountancy,
    Psychology, Mass Communication, Computer
    Science, Data Entry Operation,     Environmental
    Science, Painting.

                                                © ASSEB
                  New subjects
• Three new subjects will be introduced in class XI
  from academic year 2025-26 and from next year
  in class XII in the colleges and schools where
  wiling and competent teachers are available.
  – Sign Language : Will be introduced in colleges and
    schools where teacher or resource person is available
    having B.Ed. in special education. Any such competent
    teacher available in any primary or upper primary or
    high school or resource person of SSA, he or she may
    take classes of this subject in nearby HSS/ SSS/
    college. The training of these teachers on Sign
    Language will be provided by ASSEB , only after
    enrolment of students in class XI.

                                                  © ASSEB
                    New subjects
– Artificial Intelligence: Will be introduced in colleges and schools
  where teacher or resource person is available having personnel
  interest in this subject . Any such competent teacher available in
  any Higher Secondary or Senior Secondary school or in any
  colleges , he or she may take classes of this subject in his/her
  HSS/ SSS/ college. The training of these teachers on the Artificial
  Intelligence will be provided by ASSEB , only after enrolment of
  students in class XI in IIT Guwahati from 14th of May 2025.
– Financial Literacy: Will be introduced in colleges and schools
  where teacher or resource person is available having personnel
  interest in this subject. Any such competent teacher available in
  any Higher Secondary or Senior Secondary school or in any
  colleges, he or she may take classes of this subject in his/her
  HSS/ SSS/ college. The training of these teachers on Financial
  Literacy will be provided by ASSEB, only after enrolment of
  students in class XI in the month of June 2025.



                                                             © ASSEB
   Support to Teachers for setting concept based
                   questions
1. On the website of ASSEB DIV- I question
    Bank and sample question papers of social
    science, Science, English and Math are
    available for guidance to teachers .
2. Similarly question Bank of selected subjects
    available on the website of ASSEB DIV- II
3. The last two years question paper should
    be distributed amongst the final year
    students by collecting from the old
    students
                                              © ASSEB
   Support to introduce NSQF subjects

• Any institution can start NSQF subject in their
  institution without any approval of ASSEB.
• If the willing teacher as well as required
  facilities are available these subjects can be
  adopted.
• Text Books of all the NSQF subjects are
  available on the Website of ASSEB both in
  Division I and II.
• Third party certificate will also be arranged
